component.name: XX-Radio
component.summary: Unofficial YouTube Music player for Linux phones

description.p: Search, browse and play YouTube Music on a Linux phone: home, moods and charts, artist, album and playlist pages, radio from any song, a queue, background playback with media controls, offline downloads, lyrics and a sleep timer. Your library and playlists appear when you sign in.

XX-Radio is not affiliated with or endorsed by YouTube or Google. It uses YouTube Music's private web interface, which YouTube's terms do not permit. YouTube can break it at any time, and signing in puts that account at risk.
Spec and scaffold: launcher, placeholder window, engine interface and a demo engine.
